metaDescription: Order custom Cornerstone fleece in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Ideal for teams & events. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Cornerstone fleece combines heavy-duty durability with all-day comfort, making it a top choice for safety managers and marketing directors alike. The ANSI 107 Class 3 full-zip hoodie offers high-visibility protection without sacrificing warmth, perfect for construction crews or outdoor event staff. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or embroidery to create uniforms that stand out on the job site or at company gatherings.
heroAltText: Custom Cornerstone fleece full-zip hoodie with high-visibility safety stripes and logo embroidery
